question.text: A charged particle in a uniform magnetic field \(B=B_0 \hat{k}\) starts moving from the origin with velocity \(v=3 \hat{i}+4 \hat{k}\) m/s. The trajectory of the particle and the time \(t\) at which it reaches \(2 \mathrm{~m}\) above \(x-y\) plane are,

solution.text:
Hint :
Velocity along z-direction will be const. \(\mathrm{t}=\frac{\mathrm{s}}{V_z}=\frac{2}{4}=\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{sec}\) Path will be helical.
